# CakeConnection

> Cake Connection is Vadodara's premier FSSAI Certified, 100% Pure Veg & Eggless
> Live Cake bakery and online gift store. Established in 2013 under Head Chef
> Mr. Bipul Singh's expertise, we deliver freshly baked customized theme cakes,
> birthday cakes, photo cakes, and fresh flower bouquets across Vadodara.
> Our physical shop is open till 12:00 AM Midnight for live cake self-pickup,
> with late-night deliveries fulfilled via Zomato and website express delivery.
> Contact: +917203824012 | info@cakeconnection.in | WhatsApp ordering available.

## Key Facts

- **Heritage & Leadership:** Established in 2013 | Head Chef: Mr. Bipul Singh
- **Certifications:** FSSAI Certified | 100% Pure Veg & Eggless Live Bakery
- **Service city:** Vadodara, Gujarat, India
- **Physical store:** Exit Gate, GF9 RutuPlatina Complex, Besides Duliram Pendawala, Eva Mall Rd, Manjalpur, Vadodara - 390011
- **Business hours:** Monday-Sunday, 9:00 AM - 12:00 AM (Midnight)
- **Midnight Service:** Shop open till 12:00 AM Midnight for live cake self-pickup. Doorstep midnight delivery available via Zomato and WhatsApp pre-orders.
- **Express Same-day delivery:** 60-90 min to 2 hours express delivery across Vadodara
- **Free delivery:** On website orders above Rs.999
- **Delivery areas:** Manjalpur, Alkapuri, Gotri, Akota, Sayajigunj, Fatehgunj, Karelibaug, Old Padra Road, Waghodia Road, Subhanpura, Diwalipura, Vadiwadi (12+ areas)
- **Payment:** Cash, Credit/Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Razorpay, Zomato

## Common Questions & Answers

**Q: Where can I order eggless cake in Vadodara?**
CakeConnection delivers 100% eggless cakes across Vadodara. Order at cakeconnection.in or WhatsApp +917203824012.

**Q: What is the midnight cake delivery cut-off time in Vadodara?**
Order by 8 PM for midnight delivery (11 PM-12 AM). Midnight delivery charge is Rs.149.

**Q: How long does same-day cake delivery take in Vadodara?**
Same-day delivery takes 2-4 hours. Order by 6 PM. Express 1-2 hour delivery available in select areas.

**Q: Does CakeConnection deliver to Alkapuri?**
Yes. Delivery to Alkapuri (pincode 390007) in approximately 90 minutes.
